text:
pagerbot: INCIDENT ALERT: p99 latency > 2.5s on router-service in eu-west-1 (streaming endpoints). Auto-page to oncall.

mike_oncall: acked — oncall here. seeing p95/p99 climb on streaming routes, taily stalls. digging in.

mike_oncall: quick summary: started ~09:11 UTC, p99 spiked to ~3.8s, error rate up slightly for long-poll streaming sessions. non-stream API (sync generation) largely unaffected.

sara_sre: grabbing logs, can you post the alert graph?

mike_oncall: attaching recent sample:
```
router.stream.p99: 3800ms @ 09:13
router.stream.p95: 720ms
router.errors.rate: +0.6% (mostly 504s on forwarded connections)
```

mike_oncall: earliest diffs look like router routing policy v2 rollout (weight-calc change) promoted at 09:05 UTC to eu-west pool. commit sha: abcdef12.

kai_infra: confirmed — weight algorithm changed to include replica-local score; new calc introduced a bias for recently-warmed shards. seeing hot partitioning in eu-west pool (a subset of client keys concentrated to a few shards).

anjali_prod: any customer visible impact yet? sam_cse, you have eyes on support?

sam_cse: flagged 3 customers with chat streaming stalls, they report token delays and occasional reconnections. raising to SEs, advising temporary retry/backoff.

mike_oncall: repro logs from router show increased queueing for 5 specific backend workers (IDs: w-112,w-113,w-119,w-120,w-121). KV-cache hit rates unchanged. it looks like routing skew created hotworkers.

sara_sre: can we force-routing to fallback path? is there an override?

kai_infra: yes — we have a per-zone route weight override. two immediate mitigations: 1) revert policy rollout (unsafe during peak), or 2) set weight_override to legacy for eu-west to spread keys. I'll run override first to restore distribution.

mike_oncall: please run override now. posting command below.
```
# set legacy weight calc for eu-west routing policy
curl -XPOST https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/routing/override \
 -d '{"policy":"weight-calc","scope":"eu-west-1","value":"legacy","ttl":600}' \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN'
```

kai_infra: running override — response ok. override active (ttl 600s).

ops-bot: ACTION: routing override applied by kai_infra - scope=eu-west-1 policy=weight-calc value=legacy ttl=600s

mike_oncall: immediate improvement visible. p99 dropping from 3.8s -> 1.1s within two minutes. still above target but trending down.

sara_sre: monitoring tail — 09:18 graphs show p99 ~980ms, p95 ~640ms. error rate trending back to baseline.

sam_cse: we've notified impacted customers: "we applied traffic routing mitigation, issue is reduced. engineering continuing investigation."

anjali_prod: good. any permanent fix plan? rollback of rollout or a patch?

kai_infra: root cause: new weight-calc introduced uneven weighting when warmup_count < 3, which in eu-west coincided with a few recently scaled workers; resulted in >60% traffic to 5 workers. short term: revert in controlplane for eu-west and run canary audit across other regions. long term: patch algorithm to add jitter and shard affinity cap.

mike_oncall: I'll escalate to deploy@ for rollback windows. we should avoid full rollback during peak; propose staged rollback for eu-west only.

sara_sre: creating incident ticket with timeline and mitigation. linking runbooks.

sara_sre: INCIDENT TICKET: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3421  (summary: router weight-calc rollout -> hot partitioning -> streaming p99 spike eu-west)

mike_oncall: handoff to sara for follow-up and postmortem. I need to go to another incident. Sara, please own next steps and communication.

sara_sre: taking over. oncall handover notes: mitigation applied (weight_override), monitoring stable, p99 < 1s, no active reconnections reported in last 5m. next actions: 1) schedule eu-west rollback for weight-calc rollout, 2) postmortem draft w/ repro and fix, 3) run audit for similar bias in other regions.

sam_cse: will follow up with customers to confirm no further user impact and update tickets.

kai_infra: adding fix PR #879 to patch weight-calc to cap per-replica share and add random jitter. target hotfix rollout in 30m to staging then prod after smoke.

ops-bot: NOTE: SLO BREACH window 09:11–09:17 UTC (p99 > 2.5s). Duration: ~6m. Impacted routes: streaming.chat.*, approx 0.8% of global streaming traffic served from eu-west.

sara_sre: drafting post-incident customer note. early blameless summary: policy rollout had unintended weighting edge-case leading to hotsharding in eu-west; mitigation was routing override; follow-ups: rollback in eu-west + patch + global audit.

mike_oncall: thanks team. ping me if rollback runs into issues.

sara_sre: closing loop here: current status stable, monitoring for 30m. assigning owners: kai_infra -> patch + rollout plan, anjali_prod -> coord with product on release controls, sam_cse -> customer comms, sara_sre -> postmortem.

pagerbot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation applied, status=stabilized, severity=sev2, assigned=sara_sre.

sara_sre: also adding recommendation to ops playbook: require synthetic streaming traffic smoke in target region for 10m post-rollout before global promotion.

sam_cse: customer note sent to affected accounts, will escalate if they reopen.

mike_oncall: thanks all, lowering page.

sara_sre: end of thread — will attach postmortem when ready.
